title: The first edit of an old COD customer shows and saves $0
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds COD and keeps a credit limit of $1,000.00 stored from before the release.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-08 Cash.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
  2. Click Save.
  3. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Credit Limit shows $0.00, disabled.
  • Step 2: the customer saves.
  • Step 3: the credit limit now reads $0.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R16: “The first time such a customer (S11-R11) is edited, Edit Customer shows $0.00, disabled, and saving saves $0 (S5-R9).”
  • S5-R9: “Opening Edit Customer for a COD or Credit Hold customer that has a credit limit stored from before release shows $0.00, disabled; saving the customer saves $0.”
  • Key Decisions: “The rule applies only to customers created or edited after release: an existing COD or Credit Hold customer with a limit stored from before keeps it until the customer is next edited in Edit Customer, updated by the contacts import, or updated through the Public API with a credit term or credit limit or moved to COD or Credit Hold by Move Customers; each of those saves $0.”

From: Jira stories under epic SV-11638 (saved 23 Oct 2026, sources/JIRA-SV-11638-stories-2026-10-23.md), read 23 Oct 2026

  • Jira SV-11674 acceptance criterion: “Given a COD customer with a pre-release limit of $1,000, when Edit Customer opens, then the limit shows $0.00, disabled, and saving saves $0 (S5-R9).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
